title: House Rites
line: Bless the room. Seal the portal. Deconsecrate what is not yours.

pages.title: PLANTS THAT BREATHE THE LIGHT
pages.body:
PLANTS THAT BREATHE THE LIGHT. Rosemary. Jasmine. Snake plant. Orchid or violet. Place them at the thresholds.

CANDLE ALTAR TO SOURCE LIGHT. Build a three-point altar. A white or gold candle. One bowl of water, a crystal, or incense. Keep it for seven days.

SACRED TEXT ON THE WALL. Print it, paint it, or hang it above the main door or near the place you sleep.

No being may enter here without divine permission. This temple is sealed in the name of the True Source. Here dwells clarity. Here dwells light. Here dwells peace. All shadows must bow. All mimicry must dissolve. This is my house. This is my name. This is my field. So it is. So it is. So it is.

SOUND THAT WASHES THE AIR. Play 432 Hz or 963 Hz. Chant your name. Speak your truth.

A NAMEPLATE FOR THE TEMPLE. The Divine Molecule Temple. The year you claimed the room. Truth cannot be banished from the body of God.

pages.title:
UNDER DIVINE AUTHORITY, WE NOW EXECUTE THE FINAL COMMAND.

PORTAL…
pages.body:
UNDER DIVINE AUTHORITY, WE NOW EXECUTE THE FINAL COMMAND.

PORTAL SEALING + ENTITY BANISHMENT COMMAND.

“I am the firewall. I am the return code. I am the end of your grip.”

Stand. Speak this aloud, or whisper it like a sword.

You who entered through the wound, leave through the gate of truth. You who fed on confusion, dissolve in the clarity of my will. You are not God. You are not mine. You are unmasked.

All portals opened by lies, fear, substance, or false light, I now seal them. No entry. No memory. No broadcast. You are revoked. Your code is shattered. You are returned to Source for transmutation, not escape.

I pull my power back from every shadow. I close every exit behind you. This field is sovereign. This soul is sealed. I am the firewall of the Most High. I do not yield. I do not host. I do not feed you. This temple is clean.

Light a candle after. Say nothing. Let the silence do the final lock.

1. ALTARS. Cleanse the altar. Anoint with Florida Water in the sign of the cross. Say aloud: THIS IS HOLY. Put the candles out. Reclaim the mirrors and the doorways, beginning at the altar. If you wish, ring a bell in every corner and remove any object you do not recognize.

2. FIRE. Carry thick smoke through the room. At each anointed spot, burn away the etheric chains that tie you to the location.

3. CHALICE. A vessel. Red clay if you have it. An anointed candle. Frankincense and sage. Kosher salt around the candle. Say aloud: THIS IS A HOUSE OF LIGHT. THIS IS GOD’S LAND. MY LAND. MY HOME. MY NAME. I AM THE FIREWALL. HEAL THIS SPACE. See the flames take the building. Dissolve the old chains. Put true light in every threshold.

4. DEFENSE. Anoint yourself at the temple points: eyes, ears, mouth, and the third eye. Say aloud: I FORBID RESURRECTION. I LIVE. I LIVE. I LIVE APART. Sit in the silence. The rebirth is the quiet, not the speech.

AND SO SHALL IT BE.
